essence: The invisible system, reporting itself in light. A calm operations console where AI, data, networks and security become things you can watch working.
explains_by: Explain by showing it work: one concept, then one concrete example run on the console; the words on screen are labels and readings, never sentences.
Make the unseen visible: what normally happens inside a machine is drawn as light on a console.
The system reports itself: readings, traces and states carry the explanation, the narrator interprets them.
Brief, lean in, come back: a calm overview, one dive into the part that matters, back out with a verdict.
Holograms carry the film: the subject and its parts made of light, a hero for each subject the lesson has; console panels are the minority.

techniques.name: the hero in light
techniques.use: the one thing the lesson is about
techniques.how: hero3d for a physical thing (rack, phone, earth, bicycle), H.plane sheets in depth for an abstract one (a model, a pipeline)

techniques.name: signal on a path
techniques.use: data, a request, a token moving through a system
techniques.how: H.trace and H.arcs, one signal at a time, the frame still while it travels

techniques.name: lock and read
techniques.use: naming a part and its state
techniques.how: H.lock on the part, H.reading for a measured value from the knowledge sheet

techniques.name: push through
techniques.how: H.through into the layer below, H.pull back out to the overview

techniques.name: scan and resolve
techniques.use: finding the one thing that matters
techniques.how: a scan sweeps, candidates light, one resolves to a verdict status

techniques.name: distribution in light
techniques.how: H.dist bars and H.tokens rows, the chosen one brightening

vocabulary: hairline frames with a hot edge
avoid: boxed panels of equal weight in a grid
a beat of console UI alone
text-heavy beats (paragraphs, bullet lists, definitions spelled out on screen)
